create.compose: This server belongs to Docker Compose: start its container with Compose, not from here.
create.done: Container {{container}} created. Switch the server on and start it below.
create.failed: The container could not be created.
create.host: Or on the host, without the browser
create.title: Create the container
create.where: Run it in the directory that holds the dashboard's docker-compose.yml.
create.why: Downloads the image (often more than a gigabyte), creates the data directories and the configuration, then the container. Nothing is started yet. This is where a typo in the values above becomes real — check them first.
docker.unknown: Docker could not be asked whether the container exists: {{reason}}
error.disable: The server could not be switched off again.
error.enable: The server could not be enabled.
error.load: The setup state could not be loaded.
next.title: Next steps
off.member: An admin has switched it off or has not finished setting it up.
off.title: {{name}} is switched off
secret.admin.hint: The password of the in-game admin account (ADMINPASSWORD). Never shown again. It reaches the server when the container is recreated.
secret.admin.label: New admin password
secret.admin.notSet: Not set — the in-game admin account uses the console password.
secret.admin.title: In-game admin password
secret.envWins: A value stored here exists too; {{name}} wins as long as it is set.
secret.error: The password could not be stored.
secret.fromEnv: Set by the env variable {{name}} in the dashboard's .env.
secret.hint: Never shown again. The container receives it when it is created: after a change, recreate the container (Factorio and Avorion keep their password in a file in the data directory, which wins).
secret.label: New password
secret.missing: No console password is set: the server would start with its console closed. Set it above first.
secret.notSet: Not set — the dashboard cannot reach this server's console.
secret.title: Console password
secret.unreadable: A stored password can no longer be read (was GSS_SECRET_KEY changed?). Enter it again.
start.refused: The server could not be started, so it stays switched off: {{reason}} Fix the cause (a port, for instance, under Edit server) and try again.
subtitle: Server {{key}} is registered but switched off.
then: Once the container exists, this page offers to enable and start the server.
